parole.significato: Finnish (of or relating to Finland or Finns)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Late Latin Finnus, from Proto-Germanic *finnaz.

parole.significato: to steal (to take illegally or without permission)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese roubar, from Late Latin raubāre, from Proto-Germanic *raubōną.

parole.significato: Saxon (member of the Saxons, an ancient Germanic tribe)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Late Latin Saxōnem (“a Saxon”), from Proto-Germanic *Sahsô, probably originally a derivative of *sahsą (“rock, knife”), from Proto-Indo-European *sek- (“to cut”).

parole.significato: soup (any of various dishes commonly made by combining liquids, such as water or stock, with other ingredients, such as…
parole.testo: From Late Latin suppa (“sopped bread”), from Proto-Germanic *supô.
